notes: Investigated per rules-mandated absence check before recording NO_SEASONAL. bhv.fr is Cloudflare-protected (JS managed challenge); it was passed via the browser after multiple waits (no Claude-specific robots.txt disallow encountered — robots.txt itself never rendered past the challenge, so tier-2/3 access proceeded per the access-tier rules; no policy_opt_out signal was seen anywhere). The site is currently displaying its own 'Notre boutique en ligne est momentanement indisponible' (our online store is momentarily unavailable) banner site-wide, which degrades the product-grid renderer (product tiles/images mostly fail to mount) even though category taxonomy and product-count badges load correctly; product names were still recoverable via the accessibility tree (read_page/find), which is how the classification below was actually verified. Full Maison mega-menu inspected: Arts de la table, Culinaire, Luminaire, Mobilier, Decoration, Literie, Linge de maison, HIFI/image/sons, Informatique, Petits electromenagers, Consoles et gaming, Telephonie. Decoration's own children: Decorations murales, Encadrements, Objet deco, Coussins et plaids, Decorations festives, Decorations faune et flore, Bougies et senteurs, Rideaux et stores - none named after a specific holiday. The one plausible candidate, Decoration > Decorations festives ('Festive Decorations', 6 products total: Boules et decorations=3, Calendriers de l'avent=0, Guirlandes=3), was opened and its actual product titles read directly (bypassing the broken visual grid): Boules et decorations = 'Set de 4 ronds de serviette Rennes en bois' (reindeer - Christmas), 'Losange alveole arc-en-ciel 30x22 cm' (rainbow honeycomb - generic party), 'Set de 4 ronds de serviette Etoiles en bois' (stars - ambiguous); Guirlandes = 'Guirlande 10 fanions Amour eucalyptus...' (love/Valentine), 'Guirlande d'anniversaire - Dinosaure' (birthday), 'Guirlande - Bonne annee' (New Year). This is a genuine mixed-occasion 'festive/party decor' catch-all (Christmas + Valentine's + birthday + New Year items coexisting with no holiday-specific sub-split), not a category the site's own taxonomy associates with one specific holiday - fails the core seasonal-category test (rules sec 5/6/20), so it was excluded rather than force-classified as Christmas. Calendriers de l'avent (Advent calendars, the one sub-node that IS unambiguously Christmas-specific by French convention) currently shows 0 products and was dropped per the zero-qty rule. Also checked: Arts de la table (10 subcategories: Vaisselle, Theieres et cafetieres, Accessoires de table, Plats et plateaux, Services et presentation, Verres, Couverts de table, Carafes et pichet, Conservation et rangement, Autour du vin - none holiday-named); Luminaire (10 subcategories incl. 'Guirlandes et decorations lumineuses' [string lights, 36 products] - generic light-garland category, not named or scoped to Noel, excluded on the same generic-bucket basis); Objet deco (Objets lumineux, Statuettes et figurines, Tirelires, Vases, Cloches en verre, Serres-livres - none holiday-named); Decorations faune et flore (Fleurs artificielles, Plantes artificielles, Animaux decoratifs, 2 products - no Christmas trees or seasonal flora found); top-level Loisirs department (La niche, Jeux et jouets, Beaux arts, Loisirs creatifs, Loisirs exterieurs, Papeterie - no Noel/Fetes node). Internal site search for 'Noel' returned a non-zero, discriminating '8 Produits' (proving Christmas-tagged inventory exists somewhere on-site) but per rules a search-result page is not a category and no dedicated Noel/Christmas PLP was ever surfaced through navigation, sitemap-equivalent browsing, or the mega-menu - so no valid row could be built from it. Conclusion: BHV Marais Maison's online catalog (as currently live, early Sept 2026, pre-holiday-season) has no genuine holiday-specific product-listing category in its own taxonomy; its closest analog is a generic multi-occasion 'Decorations festives' bucket, correctly excluded.
